concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-classic-platforms-notification-types]] — 2020-modified, 2026-09-15-captured Classic event-purpose catalog for account holders, payouts, transfers, refunds and liable-account compensation; request/Initiated labels are not completion or bank-receipt proof.
warnings: `ACCOUNT_HOLDER_CREATED` also covers a creation error; `ACCOUNT_HOLDER_PAYOUT` Initiated indicates process start, not bank receipt.
The transfer and refund event entries are described as triggered by requests, so their labels alone do not establish completed funds movement.
